title: Correcting questionnaires for acquiescence bias
text: Acquiescence tendency agree questionnaire items regardless content. adds person-specific offset every response distorts scale scores, reliabilities correlations. noisecanceling treats acquiescence way noise-cancelling headphones treat ambient sound. headphones record noise play back inverted copy (180° phase); noise inverted copy cancel, leaving signal. balanced scale: trait signal; acquiescence noise, pushes responses upward positively keyed (PK) negatively keyed (NK) items; reverse-scoring NK items realigns trait signal leaving acquiescence split equal positive negative parts cancel. package estimates per-person acquiescence index balanced items centers responses , remaining variance purified measure trait.
